001package com.streamConverter.path;
002
003import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.Objects;
006import java.util.Optional;
007import java.util.stream.Stream;
008import java.util.stream.StreamSupport;
009
010/**
011 * Type-safe representation of JSONPath expressions.
012 *
013 * <p>This class encapsulates JSONPath expressions used for navigating JSON documents. It validates
014 * the path syntax at construction time and provides type safety for JSON navigation operations.
015 *
016 * <p>Supported JSONPath patterns: - Simple property access: "$.propertyName" - Nested property
017 * access: "$.level1.level2" - Array access: "$.users[0]" - Wildcard array access: "$.users[*]" -
018 * Root reference: "$"
019 *
020 * <p>Note: This is a simplified JSONPath implementation focused on the most common use cases in
021 * StreamConverter.
022 */
023public class JSONPath extends AbstractPath<JsonNode> {
024
025  private static final String TYPE = "JSONPath";
026
027  // No regex validation to completely avoid ReDoS vulnerabilities
028  // Use manual parsing for secure validation instead
029
030  private final List<String> segments;
031  private final boolean isSimpleProperty;
032  private final boolean isArrayAccess;
033  private final boolean isWildcardAccess;
034
035  /**
036   * Creates a new JSONPath instance.
037   *
038   * @param path the JSONPath expression (e.g., "$.userName", "$.users[*].name")
039   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the path is null, empty, or has invalid syntax
040   */
041  public JSONPath(String path) {
042    super(path, TYPE);
043    this.segments = parseSegments(this.path);
044    this.isSimpleProperty = detectSimpleProperty();
045    this.isArrayAccess = detectArrayAccess();
046    this.isWildcardAccess = detectWildcardAccess();
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Factory method for creating a JSONPath for root access.
051   *
052   * @return a JSONPath representing root access ("$")
053   */
054  public static JSONPath root() {
055    return new JSONPath("$");
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Factory method for creating a JSONPath for simple property access.
060   *
061   * @param propertyName the property name
062   * @return a JSONPath for the property (e.g., "$.propertyName")
063   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if propertyName is invalid
064   */
065  public static JSONPath property(String propertyName) {
066    if (propertyName == null || propertyName.trim().isEmpty()) {
067      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Property name cannot be null or empty");
068    }
069    if (!isValidIdentifier(propertyName.trim())) {
070      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid property name: " + propertyName);
071    }
072    return new JSONPath("$." + propertyName.trim());
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  public void validate() {
077    validateJsonPathSafely(path);
078  }
079
080  @Override
081  protected String validateAndNormalize(String rawPath) {
082    if (rawPath == null) {
083      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot be null");
084    }
085    if (rawPath.trim().isEmpty()) {
086      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot be empty");
087    }
088
089    // Normalize path for backward compatibility
090    String normalizedPath = normalizeJsonPath(rawPath.trim());
091    return normalizedPath;
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Manually validates JSONPath without regex to avoid ReDoS vulnerabilities. Validates patterns
096   * like: $, $.prop, $.prop[0], $.prop[*], $.prop.nested[0]
097   */
098  private static void validateJsonPathSafely(String path) {
099    if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) {
100      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot be null or empty");
101    }
102
103    // Must start with $
104    if (!path.startsWith("$")) {
105      throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath must start with '$': " + path);
106    }
107
108    // Just $ is valid (root)
109    if (path.equals("$")) {
110      return;
111    }
112
113    // Parse character by character to avoid regex vulnerabilities
114    int i = 1; // Start after '$'
115
116    while (i < path.length()) {
117      char c = path.charAt(i);
118
119      if (c == '.') {
120        // Dot must be followed by property name
121        i++; // Move past '.'
122        if (i >= path.length()) {
123          throw new IllegalArgumentException("JSONPath cannot end with '.': " + path);
124        }
125
126        // Read property name
127        int propStart = i;
128        while (i < path.length()) {
129          char propChar = path.charAt(i);
130          if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(propChar) || propChar == '_') {
131            i++;
132          } else {
133            break; // Stop at non-property character like '[' or '.'
134          }
135        }
136
137        if (i == propStart) {
138          throw new IllegalArgumentException(
139              "Empty property name after '.' at position " + propStart + ": " + path);
140        }
141
142        String propName = path.substring(propStart, i);
143        if (!isValidPropertyName(propName)) {
144          throw new IllegalArgumentException(
145              "Invalid property name '" + propName + "' at position " + propStart + ": " + path);
146        }
147
148        continue;
149      }
150
151      if (c == '[') {
152        // Parse array accessor [123] or [*]
153        int endBracket = path.indexOf(']', i);
154        if (endBracket == -1) {
155          throw new IllegalArgumentException(
156              "Missing closing bracket ']' after position " + i + ": " + path);
157        }
158
159        String arrayContent = path.substring(i + 1, endBracket);
160        if (arrayContent.equals("*")) {
161          // Wildcard is valid
162        } else if (isNumericIndex(arrayContent)) {
163          // Numeric index is valid
164        } else {
165          throw new IllegalArgumentException(
166              "Invalid array index '" + arrayContent + "' at position " + i + ": " + path);
167        }
168
169        i = endBracket + 1;
170        continue;
171      }
172
173      // If we get here, we have an unexpected character
174      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
175          "Unexpected character '" + c + "' at position " + i + ": " + path);
176    }
177  }
178
179  private static boolean isValidPropertyName(String propName) {
180    if (propName == null || propName.isEmpty()) {
181      return false;
182    }
183
184    char first = propName.charAt(0);
185    if (!Character.isLetter(first) && first != '_') {
186      return false;
187    }
188
189    for (int i = 1; i < propName.length(); i++) {
190      char c = propName.charAt(i);
191      if (!Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) && c != '_') {
192        return false;
193      }
194    }
195
196    return true;
197  }
198
199  private static boolean isNumericIndex(String index) {
200    if (index == null || index.isEmpty()) {
201      return false;
202    }
203
204    for (int i = 0; i < index.length(); i++) {
205      if (!Character.isDigit(index.charAt(i))) {
206        return false;
207      }
208    }
209
210    return true;
211  }
212
213  /**
214   * Checks if the path has array notation like property[index] or property[*] without using regex
215   * to avoid ReDoS vulnerabilities.
216   */
217  private static boolean hasArrayNotation(String path) {
218    if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) {
219      return false;
220    }
221
222    // Look for pattern: starts with valid identifier, then has [...]
223    int bracketPos = path.indexOf('[');
224    if (bracketPos == -1) {
225      return false;
226    }
227
228    // Check if there's a valid identifier before the bracket
229    String beforeBracket = path.substring(0, bracketPos);
230    if (!isValidIdentifier(beforeBracket)) {
231      return false;
232    }
233
234    // Check if there's a closing bracket
235    int closeBracketPos = path.indexOf(']', bracketPos);
236    return closeBracketPos != -1;
237  }
238
239  // === JSONPath特化メソッド ===
240
241  /**
242   * 簡単なプロパティの場合、プロパティ名を抽出
243   *
244   * @return 簡単なプロパティアクセスの場合はプロパティ名、そうでなければEmpty
245   */
246  public Optional<String> extractSimpleProperty() {
247    if (isSimpleProperty && segments.size() == 1) {
248      return Optional.of(segments.get(0));
249    }
250    return Optional.empty();
251  }
252
253  public boolean isSimplePropertyAccess() {
254    return isSimpleProperty;
255  }
256
257  public boolean isArrayAccess() {
258    return isArrayAccess;
259  }
260
261  public boolean isWildcardAccess() {
262    return isWildcardAccess;
263  }
264
265  // === AbstractPath実装 ===
266
267  @Override
268  protected boolean doMatches(JsonNode context) {
269    // 簡易実装: 単純なプロパティアクセスのみ
270    try {
271      if (isSimpleProperty && segments.size() == 1) {
272        return context.has(segments.get(0));
273      }
274      return false;
275    } catch (Exception e) {
276      return false;
277    }
278  }
279
280  @Override
281  protected <R> Optional<R> doExtract(Object data, Class<R> resultType) {
282    validateResultType(resultType);
283
284    try {
285      JsonNode jsonNode;
286
287      // データをJsonNodeに変換
288      if (data instanceof JsonNode) {
289        jsonNode = (JsonNode) data;
290      } else if (data instanceof String) {
291        try {
292          com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper mapper =
293              new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
294          jsonNode = mapper.readTree((String) data);
295        } catch (Exception e) {
296          return Optional.empty();
297        }
298      } else {
299        return Optional.empty();
300      }
301
302      // JSONPath処理ロジック統合
303      JsonNode resultNode = navigateJsonPath(jsonNode);
304      if (resultNode != null && !resultNode.isMissingNode() && !resultNode.isNull()) {
305        if (resultType == String.class) {
306          return Optional.of(resultType.cast(resultNode.asText()));
307        } else if (resultType == JsonNode.class) {
308          return Optional.of(resultType.cast(resultNode));
309        }
310      }
311      return Optional.empty();
312    } catch (Exception e) {
313      return Optional.empty();
314    }
315  }
316
317  @Override
318  protected <R> Stream<R> doExtractAll(Object data, Class<R> resultType) {
319    validateResultType(resultType);
320
321    try {
322      // 配列/リスト結果を想定した実装
323      if (data instanceof JsonNode) {
324        JsonNode jsonNode = (JsonNode) data;
325
326        if (jsonNode.isArray()) {
327          return StreamSupport.stream(jsonNode.spliterator(), false)
328              .filter(node -> !node.isMissingNode())
329              .map(
330                  node -> {
331                    if (resultType == String.class) {
332                      return resultType.cast(node.asText());
333                    }
334                    return null;
335                  })
336              .filter(Objects::nonNull);
337        }
338      }
339      return Stream.empty();
340    } catch (Exception e) {
341      return Stream.empty();
342    }
343  }
344
345  // === 内部実装メソッド ===
346
347  private List<String> parseSegments(String normalizedPath) {
348    // $.user.name -> ["user", "name"]
349    // $.users[*].name -> ["users[*]", "name"]
350    if (normalizedPath.equals("$")) {
351      return List.of();
352    }
353
354    String withoutRoot = normalizedPath.substring(2); // $.を除去
355    if (withoutRoot.isEmpty()) {
356      return List.of();
357    }
358
359    return List.of(withoutRoot.split("\\."));
360  }
361
362  private boolean detectSimpleProperty() {
363    return segments.size() == 1 && !segments.get(0).contains("[") && !segments.get(0).contains("*");
364  }
365
366  private boolean detectArrayAccess() {
367    return segments.stream().anyMatch(s -> s.contains("["));
368  }
369
370  private boolean detectWildcardAccess() {
371    return segments.stream().anyMatch(s -> s.contains("*"));
372  }
373
374  /** JSONPathナビゲーション処理（JsonNavigateCommandから統合） */
375  private JsonNode navigateJsonPath(JsonNode rootNode) {
376    if (isRoot()) {
377      return rootNode;
378    }
379
380    // 単純なプロパティアクセス
381    Optional<String> simpleProperty = extractSimpleProperty();
382    if (simpleProperty.isPresent()) {
383      return rootNode.get(simpleProperty.get());
384    }
385
386    // 複雑なパスの場合はJsonPointerを使用
387    String pathStr = getPath();
388    if (pathStr.startsWith("$.")) {
389      String propertyPath = pathStr.substring(2);
390      return rootNode.at("/" + propertyPath.replace(".", "/"));
391    }
392
393    return rootNode;
394  }
395
396  /**
397   * ストリーミング処理用のパス判定メソッド JSON階層パスのリアルタイム判定に使用（XMLのpathHandlerと同様）
398   *
399   * @param currentPath 現在のJSONパス階層
400   * @return パスがマッチする場合true
401   */
402  public boolean matchesStreamingPath(java.util.List<String> currentPath) {
403    if (currentPath == null) {
404      return false;
405    }
406
407    // ルートパス("$")の場合
408    if (isRoot()) {
409      return currentPath.isEmpty();
410    }
411
412    // セグメント数が一致しない場合はfalse
413    if (currentPath.size() != segments.size()) {
414      return false;
415    }
416
417    // 各セグメントを順次比較（XMLのisTargetと同じロジック）
418    for (int i = 0; i < segments.size(); i++) {
419      if (!segments.get(i).equals(currentPath.get(i))) {
420        return false;
421      }
422    }
423
424    return true;
425  }
426
427  // === 既存メソッド保持 ===
428
429  /**
430   * Checks if this is a root path ("$").
431   *
432   * @return true if this represents root access
433   */
434  public boolean isRoot() {
435    return "$".equals(path);
436  }
437
438  /**
439   * Checks if this path involves array access.
440   *
441   * @return true if the path contains array notation
442   */
443  public boolean hasArrayAccess() {
444    return path.contains("[");
445  }
446
447  /**
448   * Checks if this path uses wildcard array access.
449   *
450   * @return true if the path contains wildcard array notation
451   */
452  public boolean hasWildcardAccess() {
453    return path.contains("[*]");
454  }
455
456  /**
457   * Get the simple property name if this path represents a simple property access like "$.name".
458   *
459   * @return Optional containing the property name, or empty if not a simple property access
460   */
461  public Optional<String> findSimpleProperty() {
462    if (path.startsWith("$.") && !path.contains("[") && path.lastIndexOf('.') == 1) {
463      return Optional.of(path.substring(2));
464    }
465    return Optional.empty();
466  }
467
468  private static boolean isValidIdentifier(String identifier) {
469    if (identifier == null || identifier.isEmpty()) {
470      return false;
471    }
472
473    char first = identifier.charAt(0);
474    if (!(Character.isLetter(first) || first == '_')) {
475      return false;
476    }
477
478    for (int i = 1; i < identifier.length(); i++) {
479      char c = identifier.charAt(i);
480      if (!(Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '_')) {
481        return false;
482      }
483    }
484
485    return true;
486  }
487
488  /**
489   * Normalizes a path for backward compatibility. Converts bare property names to proper JSONPath
490   * syntax.
491   */
492  private String normalizeJsonPath(String path) {
493    // If already starts with $, assume it's correct
494    if (path.startsWith("$")) {
495      return path;
496    }
497
498    // If it's a simple identifier, convert to $.identifier
499    if (isValidIdentifier(path)) {
500      return "$." + path;
501    }
502
503    // If it contains array notation but no $, assume it needs $
504    if (hasArrayNotation(path)) {
505      return "$." + path;
506    }
507
508    // Return as-is for other cases (will be validated later)
509    return path;
510  }
511
512  @Override
513  public String toString() {
514    return String.format("JSONPath('%s')", path);
515  }
516
517  @Override
518  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
519    if (this == obj) return true;
520    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
521    JSONPath jsonPath = (JSONPath) obj;
522    return Objects.equals(path, jsonPath.path);
523  }
524
525  @Override
526  public int hashCode() {
527    return Objects.hash(path);
528  }
529}
